claims.sentence: Observational studies suggest that aspirin use may induce cerebral microbleeds, and associated overt intracranial hemorrhage, but this has not been definitively resolved.</jats:p> </jats:sec> <jats:sec> <jats:title>Aims</jats:title> <jats:p>ASPREE-NEURO will determine the effect of aspirin on cerebral microbleed development over three years in healthy adults aged 70 years and over, participating in the larger ‘ASPirin in Reducing Events in the Elderly (ASPREE)’ primary prevention study of aspirin.</jats:p> </jats:sec> <jats:sec> <jats:title>Sample size</jats:title> <jats:p>Five hundred and fifty-nine participants provide 75% power (two-sided p value of 0.05) to determine an average difference of 0.5 cerebral microbleed per person after three years.</jats:p> </jats:sec> <jats:sec> <jats:title>Methods and design</jats:title> <jats:p>A multi-center, randomized placebo-controlled trial of 100 mg daily aspirin in participants who have brain magnetic resonance imaging at study entry, one and three years after randomization and who undergo cognitive testing at the same time points.</jats:p> </jats:sec> <jats:sec> <jats:title>Study outcomes</jats:title> <jats:p>The primary outcome is the number of new cerebral microbleeds on magnetic resonance imaging after three years.
